title: Panigale V4 R Homologation (Apex Spec)
description: Representing Ducati's prowess in the Homologation Superbike class, the Ducati Panigale V4 R Homologation (Apex Spec) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
